operation: §180 — bounded clarification settlement architecture review (LOCAL, zero provider calls)
shape: option B/C delivered as one staged design, beginning with stage A0 which exercises the EXISTING architecture and can still overturn the recommendation before any new field is written

evidenceBase.finding: the settlement state already exists and is unreachable
evidenceBase.detail: SETTLED_BY_EVIDENCE requires an ADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE authority, and no code path in the repository mints it. The single minting site produces ADMITTED_BINDING. Today a fact can only leave UNRESOLVED by being asked about.

evidenceBase.finding: the challenge channel has a producer and no consumer
evidenceBase.detail: CHALLENGE_FACT_VALIDITY — instructed as 'the observation already settles it', which is HR-04's sentence — produces an ArbitrationRequest that nothing consumes.

evidenceBase.finding: the provider is never asked what property its evidence establishes
evidenceBase.detail: it receives the target and returns one of three bookkeeping tokens. The comparison §178 tried to teach in prose is the one step the structured channel does not represent.

evidenceBase.finding: both §179 failure shapes occurred where the architecture is absent
evidenceBase.detail: HR-04, HR-05 and HR-07 ran through the first-pass v15 prompt, which has no ledger, no factKey and no binding. §179 is therefore NOT evidence against the existing architecture.

justification: the proposal completes two structures the architecture already committed to, rather than inventing a new concept: a declared-but-unreachable settlement state, and a claims queue with no consumer
§179 showed the settlement decision being made in prose with no structured trace — a diagnosis problem before it is a correctness problem, and prompt-only continuation cannot fix a diagnosis problem

the determinism and semantic boundaries survive intact: every new check is a property of form, the semantic judgement stays human, acceptableEvidence stays guidance, the status set stays closed at four, and no closed property ontology is introduced
it degrades gracefully — where a governed criterion is null, which is most facts today, behaviour is identical to today with the gap reported rather than filled by invention
three prompt identities have now failed to move HR-04, and §179 replicate 3 reasoned explicitly through presence, the pre-start check and the historical torque verification before settling the fact

whyNotEachAlternative.A_CONTINUE_PROMPT_ONLY: not refuted as a category and explicitly not barred — but as the sole next step it repeats a loop that has failed three times and, more importantly, cannot report why. Every attempt costs a replicated hosted validation to evaluate.
whyNotEachAlternative.C_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_NOT_YET_JUSTIFIED: this was the closest competitor, on the strength of Finding 4 — the existing architecture has never run on the failing rows. It is answered by making stage A0, not a new field, the first thing that happens. The recommendation is staged so this objection is tested rather than argued.
whyNotEachAlternative.D_GOVERNED_KNOWLEDGE_REMEDIATION_REQUIRE: rejected as a prerequisite because the architecture must fail transparently on null and coarse criteria regardless; if it needed a clean registry to be safe it would be the wrong architecture. The AUDIT half is recommended early, in parallel.
whyNotEachAlternative.E_DETERMINISTIC_SEMANTIC_GATE: refused outright — violates non-negotiable constraint 2 and rebuilds the keyword scorer §160/§161 retired.

constraintCompliance.1_verifier_v3_remains_inactive: PRESERVED — EXPERT_VERIFIER_V3_DEVELOPMENT_ENABLED stays the literal false through every proposed stage; no environment flag, settings toggle, customer toggle or runtime activation path is proposed. Customer activation is not in the sequence.
constraintCompliance.2_semantic_sufficiency_remains_semantic: PRESERVED — no similarity threshold, embedding score, keyword score, overlap percentage, regex or property matcher is proposed, and stage E must prove none exists. CLARIFICATION_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY = SEMANTIC_JUDGMENT_REQUIRED is unchanged. Exact factKey coverage remains deterministic.
constraintCompliance.3_acceptableEvidence_remains_guidance: PRESERVED — it is what a human compares a declaration against, never what code compares it against. It is not proof that supplied evidence satisfies the criterion and does not become a validator.
constraintCompliance.4_no_closed_property_ontology: PRESERVED — Q1 selects reuse of acceptableEvidence.requirement, a SENTENCE, over any new property field or enum. Status stays closed; reasons stay open text.
constraintCompliance.5_governed_knowledge_limitation_stays_vi: PRESERVED — coarse criteria are projected unchanged, provenance is carried into observability, a claim against a null criterion is flagged, and the architecture never pretends to stronger source knowledge than the governed record provides.
constraintCompliance.6_adjacent_hazards_remain_additive: PRESERVED — nomination stays additive and structurally cannot express replacement; the review explicitly rejects any rule that suppresses adjacent nominations because the owed fact was settled.

governedKnowledgeGapClassification.reason: not a prerequisite because the architecture must fail transparently on null and coarse criteria anyway; not merely a later improvement because the misalignment is documented and concrete (app-mg-01 asks presence AND function while its verification method may establish only inspection/presence)
governedKnowledgeGapClassification.prohibition: governed records must never be strengthened to make this architecture work

firstAuthorizationSought.stage: A0 — exercise the existing architecture on the frozen §179 rows, plus the alignment AUDIT
firstAuthorizationSought.whyThisFirst: it is the cheapest thing that could overturn this recommendation, and it costs no new code and no new schema
firstAuthorizationSought.note: authorizing A0 is NOT authorizing stages A through G. Each stage is separately authorized.

mustNotClaim: that the architecture fixes displaced-valid-fact leakage
alsoNotClaimed: PROMPT_ENGINEERING_CANNOT_SOLVE_SETTLEMENT — not established, and v15 was one wording at one placement
that the existing inactive architecture would have prevented the §179 failures — it was never running on those rows and the question is unmeasured in both directions
CLAIM_BOUNDARY.whatThisReviewIs: a design recommendation supported by reading the implementation. Any behavioural claim requires implementation and later hosted evidence.

unchangedByThisReview.section179Figures: 12/15 strict REQUIRED, 12/15 SILENCE, 24/30 overall — unchanged and not re-measured
